fact: The second draft Artificial Intelligence Policy and Implementation Plan, led by the Ministry, says Lesotho has no direct AI regulation and plans a three-tier AI governance setup with a temporary committee to implement it, scheduled for 2025 Q2 to 2026 Q2.
title: Artificial Intelligence Policy and Implementation Plan (Second Draft)
publisher: Ministry of Information, Communications, Science, Technology and Innovation (MICSTI), Lesotho
